# gtme init

Create ~/.gtme and the ledger.

## Forms

```
gtme init
```

It exits with one of the [exit codes](/reference/cli#exit-codes) every verb shares.

## Example

From [Install](/start/install):

```sh
gtme init
```

- [Install](/start/install): The command that creates ~/.gtme and the ledger
